subject.title: refactor(qqbot): adopt core typing keepalive loop with budget accounting intact

question: Should `createTypingKeepaliveLoop` become a durable third-party API now despite the linked program assigning this phase no public API changes?
rationale: The shared-loop refactor is mechanically sound, but only channel and plugin SDK owners can authorize the added compatibility contract or decide to defer the QQ migration.

options.title: Defer the public export
options.body: Keep QQ’s scheduler local for this phase and revisit the migration when the channel SDK contract is intentionally designed.

options.title: Approve the SDK contract now
options.body: Keep the export, document its supported lifecycle semantics, add direct SDK contract coverage, and resolve the surface budgets against current main.

recommendation.title: Defer the public export
recommendation.body: Keep QQ’s scheduler local for this phase and revisit the migration when the channel SDK contract is intentionally designed.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked program and its phase boundaries were proposed under this contributor’s channel-contract work.
